preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 50 for x in stdin.split()[:4])
preconditions.description: All input integers n_1, n_2, k_1, k_2 are between 1 and 50 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is 'First' if the first player can force a win with optimal play, otherwise 'Second'. The first player wins if either (1) the first player's balls modulo (k_1 + 1) is nonzero (immediate winning move), or (2) the second player's balls modulo (k_2 + 1) is zero (second player cannot force a win from their position).
